description: 35 Ke geluidszonering vliegveld (OGV, 2010) (historie) is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. In de door Provinciale Staten op 2 juni 2010 vastgestelde Omgevingsvisie is het uitgangspunt dat de wettelijke normen voor nieuwe luchtvaartactiviteiten niet overschreden mogen worden en dat ook rekening moet worden gehouden met de regelgeving over Natura2000- en stiltegebieden (kaart 12). Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are geluid, geluidhinder, geluidszones, luchtvaart, omgevingsvisie. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/ZIP. The portal shows 2024-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
